title: JavaClassWrapper code for vibration not working
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot v4.4

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - macOS Sonoma (14.6.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M1 (Apple7) - Apple M1 (8 threads)

### Issue description

I am trying to use the new feature of mapping Java code of Android to Gdscript, here is the sample code

```
func _on_button_pressed() -> void:
	
	if android_runtime:
		print("Checking if the device supports vibration")
		label.text = "1"
		var vibrator_service = android_runtime.getApplicationContext().getSystemService("vibrator")
		label.text = "2"
		if vibrator_service:
			label.text = "3"
			if vibrator_service.hasVibrator():
				label.text = "4"
				print("Vibration is supported on device! Vibrating now...")
				var VibrationEffect = android_runtime.loadClass("android.os.VibrationEffect")
				var effect = VibrationEffect.createOneShot(500, VibrationEffect.DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE)
				vibrator_service.vibrate(effect)
				#vibrator_service.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createOneShot(500, VibrationEffect.DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE));
				#vibrator_service.vibrate(android_runtime.VibrationEffect.createOneShot(500, android_runtime.VibrationEffect.DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE));
				#vibrator_service.vibrate(android_runtime.createVibrationEffect(500, "default"))
				label.text = "5"
			else:
				printerr("Vibration is not supported on device")
				label_2.text = "6"
		else:
			printerr("Unable to retrieve the vibrator service")
			label_2.text = "7"
	else:
		printerr("Couldn't find AndroidRuntime singleton")
		label_2.text = "8"
```

as you can see I have tried a couple of ways and have commented few stuff along the way but nothing seems to be working for me

I have added the vibrator permission as well 

### Steps to reproduce

1. Download the code from https://github.com/BraveEvidence/GodotAndroidVibrationNotWorking
2. Install the android build template
3. Run the project on android device

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/BraveEvidence/GodotAndroidVibrationNotWorking
